target_customer: Commercial contractors (roofing, HVAC, electrical, plumbing) and finance teams
problem: Back office work such as expense reconciliation and maintenance scheduling is manual across many tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS agent platform, pricing not shown
product_category: AI agents for back office automation

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that build, test and repair workflows across many apps on LLM APIs; reliability is the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and workflow history create some lock in; models are third party.

market_need_then: The original 2024 pitch was AI agents for financial analysts doing private markets diligence (YC launch); demand evidence not opened.

branding.domain_note: Site on decisional.com per YC page; a directory lists getdecisional.ai, unverified

identity.visual_style: Minimal, black logo, dark product UI

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name similar to many decision AI firms; no brand press found.

pivots.from: AI agent for financial analysts and private markets diligence
pivots.to: AI agents for commercial contractors' back office

outcome_analysis: Decisional launched in YC Summer 2024 as an AI analyst for private markets and later narrowed to AI agents for commercial contractors, with offices in San Francisco and London. Funding and traction are not credibly documented, so the outcome is unknown and the pivot is the main fact.
notes: VCBacked and PitchBook list about 500K pre-seed (Sept 2024) with YC, Moonfire and others; aggregators only, so not recorded as a round. A 15M Series A claim on Signalbase is uncorroborated; Latka says no outside funding. Company Notion page says it is backed by YC, Character Capital, Moonfire and NVIDIA Inception, no round given. Pivot date unknown. Success factor successful_pivot is tentative. Outcome search found nothing negative.
